name: Klaus-Dieter Richter
bio:
Klaus-Dieter's precision engineering background began in automotive manufacturing before his passion for motorsport drew him into the racing world. His meticulous nature quickly made him an indispensable part of several Formula teams where he honed his skills in data analysis and vehicle dynamics. He approaches every challenge with a systematic mindset, believing that even the smallest detail can have a significant impact on track performance.

He joined Brasil Racing three years ago seeking a fresh challenge and the opportunity to contribute to a growing team. Known for his relentless pursuit of optimal performance, Klaus-Dieter is never satisfied with 'good enough' and constantly seeks innovative solutions to extract every last tenth of a second. He is a firm believer in clear communication and data-driven decisions, which has sometimes made him a demanding figure within the team, but his results speak for themselves.

 What sets Klaus-Dieter apart is his encyclopedic knowledge of vehicle setups and his ability to quickly diagnose issues based on subtle nuances in driver feedback and telemetry data. He is the go-to person when the team is chasing that elusive perfect balance, and his insights are highly valued by drivers and engineers alike.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A man of medium height with a sturdy build, Klaus-Dieter always appears focused and intense.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations and observations.
Has a particular fondness for strong coffee and drinks it constantly throughout the day.
Insists on using metric units exclusively, even when others are using imperial.
